verdict.rationale: A changelog entry ('Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI') shows that Hoppscotch imports OpenAPI specs into collections and organizes requests into tag-based folders. Collection imports are corroborated elsewhere, but OpenAPI import itself rests on a single changelog line. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the OpenAPI import flow, supported spec versions (OpenAPI 2/3, YAML/JSON), how requests and parameters are generated, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
